item.title: Show HN: Ansi.md – Everything I know about building modern CLI apps
item.summary: Somewhere between a brain dump, custom toolset, think piece and hacker toy. This is pretty much everything I know about ansi color in the terminal and building cli apps. Includes my own fumbling attempt to finally name the ansi256 color palette. AI statement: I like my writing voice and I do not use LLMs to write.
